recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-7589 core source change is needed; future bodySite/bodyStructure cardinality or guidance changes should be handled under newer tickets such as FHIR-39630, FHIR-50083, or FHIR-54843.
issue_request: FHIR-7589 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care issue for DSTU1 that objected to Condition.location.site[x] being a choice of CodeableConcept or BodySite reference and requested a simpler inline body-site representation with laterality support handled outside that choice.
initial_application: Git commit 35ae82d571ad6a2c9a518bd356fadaf63acf2837 explicitly mentions #7589, #7629, and #8474 and changed Condition.location/site[x] into Condition.bodySite as a CodeableConcept while updating Condition examples. Current source contains no Condition.location.site[x], siteCodeableConcept, or equivalent old-model reference.
additional_context: FHIR-7629 and FHIR-8474 were part of the same 2015 Condition body-site change family. FHIR-31027 later clarified the Condition.bodySite/BodyStructure extension guidance while keeping the element name. FHIR-39630 was later Applied/Persuasive and intentionally added Condition.bodyStructure 0..1 Reference(BodyStructure) with a mutual-exclusion invariant against Condition.bodySite, so the current reference is not a regression against FHIR-7589. The Extension Pack still contains the BodyStructure Reference extension for Condition.bodySite. FHIR-54843 is a newer Resolved - change required BodyStructure guidance issue and was treated only as background because it is not yet Applied/Published in this default run.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active Condition source has Condition.bodySite as 0..* CodeableConcept, binding guidance that may include laterality, no stale local standard-extension comment, and a separate Condition.bodyStructure element added by later final Jira work. source/fhir.ini confirms Condition is an active current-build resource.

related_jiras.note: Observation had the parallel 2015 body-site simplification and informed the seed resolution, but it is a different artifact/work group.
Condition.location was renamed to bodySite in the same historical source commit that applied FHIR-7589.
Condition laterality concerns were applied in the same historical Condition bodySite commit.
Clarified Condition.bodySite/BodyStructure extension wording before the later FHIR-39630 change removed that local comment.
Intentionally added Condition.bodyStructure as a base Reference(BodyStructure), superseding the old extension-only approach for that use case.
Later Extension Pack laterality work concerns external extension modeling, not a current core fix for FHIR-7589.
A newer Resolved - change required BodyStructure guidance issue was noted but not decided because it is outside the default Applied/Published seed scope.
